name: credit_control_tabicl
caption: Final credit-benchmark differences from 0% continuation at the same backbone and peak learning rate, after 1,500 updates. Large points average paired dataset effects over five folds and two training seeds; intervals resample datasets (nominal 95%) and small markers show seed means. Positive ROC-AUC or R² and negative log-loss or CRPS differences favor the credit mixture.

name: dataset_effects_tabicl
caption: Final credit performance difference from the matched 0% continuation for every credit dataset, mixture and fixed peak rate of one backbone. Cells average five folds and two training seeds; the diverging color scale is symmetric about zero and positive ROC-AUC or R² differences favor the credit mixture.

name: credit_ood_control
caption: Credit versus native-OOD performance differences from equally trained 0% continuation at the same backbone and fixed peak rate. Colors identify mixtures and marker shapes identify rates; small points show seed means. Horizontal and vertical bars independently resample the two dataset domains (nominal 95% intervals), after averaging five folds and two training seeds. Higher ROC-AUC or R² is better on both axes.

name: credit_ood_released
caption: Credit versus native-OOD performance differences from matching released weights after 1,500 continuation updates, including the 0% generic controls. Colors identify mixtures and shapes distinguish the two fixed rates within each backbone. Bars are separate nominal 95% paired-dataset bootstrap intervals and small points show seed means. Negative ROC-AUC or R² indicates degradation from the released model.
